name: Skychaser the Elder
summary: During the Lunar Festival, Skychaser the Elder watches over Westfall from Sentinel Tower. Travelers climb to honor her as an ancestral spirit, and she recognizes the living with a blessing.

sections.title: A Beacon in the Dust
sections.body: Sentinel Hill is Westfall's lone fortified redoubt. Below, weary soldiers and settlers face threats from Defias raiders and roving scavengers across the scrublands. During the Lunar Festival, Elder Skychaser appears on the open platform atop Sentinel Tower, watching from above the dust and wind. Anyone may climb and pay her respect.

sections.title: Honoring the Ancestors
sections.body: Across Azeroth, the Lunar Festival honors wisdom, heritage, and the deeds of ancient spirits. When you approach, Elder Skychaser recognizes the living spark within you and accepts your homage. She gives you a token of her favor, binding the living to the honored dead.

faq.q: Where can I find Elder Skychaser?
faq.answer: Elder Skychaser waits atop Sentinel Tower at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. Climb the spiral stairs to the upper lookout ramparts.

faq.q: Why is Elder Skychaser standing on top of Sentinel Tower?
aliases: why is he in sentinel tower
faq.answer: During the Lunar Festival, ancestral spirits appear at prominent, symbolic places across Azeroth. From Sentinel Tower's heights, Elder Skychaser watches travelers brave the Westfall basin frontier.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: You honor ancestral elders during the Lunar Festival by seeking Elder Skychaser. Your respect earns a Coin of Ancestry and a blessing that celebrates your living spirit.

faq.q: Can Horde players honor Elder Skychaser?
faq.answer: Elder Skychaser welcomes all pilgrims, but Sentinel Hill is a heavily defended Alliance outpost. Reaching her is perilous for Horde adventurers.

faq.q: Does Elder Skychaser participate in the defense of Sentinel Hill?
aliases: is skychaser part of the people's militia
faq.answer: No. The Lunar Festival elders are spiritual manifestations devoted to tradition and remembrance. Elder Skychaser takes no part in the People's Militia's skirmishes against the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.q: What does Skychaser say when you greet her?
faq.answer: Elder Skychaser tells you that your spirit burns brightly with life. She accepts your homage and offers an ancestral token in return.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you find Elder Skychaser within the People's Militia base at Sentinel Hill. She is easy to honor while you travel through Westfall.
As a Horde traveler, you face hostile Alliance guards and militia scouts at Sentinel Hill. Reaching Elder Skychaser calls for stealth, speed, or brute force.
As a druid, you honor the Lunar Festival and its ancestral spirits. Skychaser links ancient traditions with deep reverence for nature.
